name: poisson2d-dmda
summary: Verified 2-D Poisson solver on a structured DMDA (second-order 5-point FD) with a method-of-manufactured-solutions convergence harness.
provides: main() simulation with a built-in refinement/convergence study
manufactured forcing + exact solution + Dirichlet data
L2 and Linf error norms and observed-order reporting
reuse: Adapt forcing(), uExact(), gBC(), and the 5-point stencil for related elliptic problems on structured grids; keep the MMS harness and error/convergence reporting.
verification: make run  ->  observed order ~2.00 in L2 and Linf; CG + GAMG give mesh-independent iteration counts (verified on 4 MPI ranks).
